skill.name: ponytail-debt
skill.description: Collect ponytail: comments into a technical debt ledger with file locations, stated limits, and upgrade triggers. Report without changing files by default.
skill.summary: Track marked technical debt and flag missing upgrade triggers in a read-only repository report.
skill.author: dietrichgebert

content.user_title: Collect Ponytail Comments into a Technical Debt Ledger
content.value_statement: Deferred work becomes difficult to track when its limits and upgrade triggers remain scattered across code comments. This skill collects marked comments into a ledger and flags missing triggers.
actual_capabilities: Search repository comments for ponytail: markers while directing exclusion of dependencies, Git metadata, and build output.
Group ledger rows by file and include each marker location.
Extract stated limits and upgrade triggers directly from comments.
Tag comments without an upgrade path or trigger as no-trigger.
Report total markers and missing triggers, or return a clean-ledger message.
Optionally add Git blame attribution or save the ledger when requested.
limitations: Only marked comments are collected; unmarked debt and ordinary TODO comments are outside the defined search.
Other comment prefixes require adaptation, and the example grep command needs explicit directory exclusions.
Limits and upgrade triggers depend on comment quality; the skill does not verify whether limits have been reached.
This is an instruction-only, one-shot report, not continuous monitoring, automatic remediation, or issue tracker integration.

use_cases.title: Review deferred implementation work
use_cases.description: Collect marked shortcuts with their limits and upgrade triggers before planning maintenance.

use_cases.title: Identify incomplete debt records
use_cases.description: Review markers without upgrade triggers and discuss missing criteria with the team.

use_cases.title: Prepare a maintenance handover
use_cases.description: Produce a grouped ledger and optionally add Git blame attribution for follow-up discussions.

prompt_templates.title: List marked technical debt
prompt_templates.prompt: Run ponytail-debt on this repository. Report the ledger without changing files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain a one-shot debt report.

prompt_templates.title: Review missing triggers
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect ponytail: comments by file. Include stated limits, flag missing upgrade triggers, and report totals. Do not invent missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review the quality of existing debt comments.

prompt_templates.title: Add attribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a ponytail debt ledger with Git blame attribution. Skip dependencies, Git metadata, and build output. Leave repository files unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: add historical attribution for maintenance planning.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt and save the report
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the marker search to this repository's comment syntax and build directories. Include attribution and missing-trigger counts. Save the ledger to PONYTAIL-DEBT.md.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: customize the search and explicitly request persistence.

output: Simplified cache. Ceiling: 100 entries. Upgrade: when the limit is exceeded.

output: Simplified queue. Ceiling: one worker. Upgrade: not specified. Tag: no-trigger.

output_examples.input: The repository search finds no matching ponytail: comments.

best_practices: Record a concrete limit and upgrade trigger in every ponytail: comment.
Confirm search exclusions and comment prefixes match the repository before relying on totals.
Review reported locations and request saving explicitly when a persistent ledger is needed.
anti_patterns: Treating an empty ledger as proof that the repository contains no technical debt.
Inventing limits, upgrade triggers, or current ownership when comments and history do not establish them.
Assuming the report fixes code, creates tickets, or updates automatically.

faq.question: Which comments does this skill collect?
faq.answer: It collects ponytail: markers in code comments. The example search covers hash and double-slash prefixes; other comment styles require adaptation.

faq.question: Does it change repository files?
faq.answer: No files change by default. Saving a ledger requires an explicit request.

faq.question: What does each ledger row contain?
faq.answer: Each row includes a file location, the simplification, its stated limit, and its upgrade trigger. Rows are grouped by file.

faq.question: How are missing upgrade triggers handled?
faq.answer: Comments without an upgrade path or trigger receive a no-trigger tag. The final summary counts these markers.

faq.question: Can it identify an owner?
faq.answer: Optional Git blame attribution can identify the associated commit author. This does not establish current ownership.

faq.question: What does a clean ledger mean?
faq.answer: No matching ponytail: comments were found within the search scope. Unmarked technical debt may still exist.
